title: Interaction of cardiomyocytes from CCND2-overexpressing human induced pluripotent stem cells with electrically conductive hydrogels
content:

Biomaterials like gold nanorod-embedded gelatin methacrylate (GelMA-GNR) hydrogels support the delivery of regenerative cells such as human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes (hiPSC-CMs), enhancing EHT performance.
